Title: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra service now generally available
Services: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra

Body.Content:
Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra is a new service that automates deployment, scaling, and management operations for open-source Apache Cassandra datacenters. It is an ideal service if you want to create hybrid deployments that can extend the capacity in your existing on-premises or cloud datacenters.

Learn more.
